name: Transcendent Sword
main_effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 11000 DP or less. If you have a Digimon in play with [Omnimon] or [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon] or [DexDoruGreymon]), delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 15000 DP or less instead.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effect.
